FAMILY 09 · CT/MRI 检查级基础模型：输入单位从切片走向完整 studyVolumetric Study FMs

Decipher-MR

Decipher-MR 明确采用 8³ patch 的 3D ViT-Base、DINOv2/iBOT 视觉预训练、PubMedBERT MLM，再做器官感知的 MRI-report CLIP 对齐。

3D MRI vision–language foundation model combining an 8³-patch 3D ViT-Base (pretrained via 3D DINOv2/iBOT) with PubMedBERT MLM and organ-aware MRI–report CLIP alignment.

INPUT DOMAIN // 输入域 单个 3D MRI series 与同 study 的器官级报告文本 3D MRI series volume + paired study-level organ-parsed radiology report text
OUTPUT TARGET // 输出目标 512 维共享 MRI—文本 embedding、冻结视觉特征及轻量下游 decoder 输出 512-D shared 3D MRI–text embedding and frozen 3D visual features for lightweight downstream decoders

COMPUTATION GRAPH // 9 STAGES

架构前向计算节点拆解 Forward Pass Computation Nodes

STAGE 01 / 09 · 3D MRI series3D MRI series 跨器官、序列和病理；预处理后形成可变尺寸体积 Ingests 3d mri series volume + paired study-level organ-parsed radiology report text and prepares initial tensor representations (3D MRI series).
  1. 01
    3D MRI series跨器官、序列和病理；预处理后形成可变尺寸体积Ingests 3d mri series volume + paired study-level organ-parsed radiology report text and prepares initial tensor representations (3D MRI series).
  2. 02
    8×8×8 volume patches非重叠子体积线性投影；三线性位置插值支持不同尺寸Executes 8×8×8 volume patches to extract primary structural features and establish spatial/sequence encoding.
  3. 03
    3D ViT-Base student86M 参数、768 维视觉 encoderPerforms 3D ViT-Base student within the core organ aware 3d vit mri report clip computation pathway.
  4. 04
    EMA teacher + iBOT图像级多裁剪自蒸馏和遮挡 patch 预测联合预训练Performs EMA teacher + iBOT within the core organ aware 3d vit mri report clip computation pathway.
  5. 05
    器官级 MRI 报告organ MRI清洗后提取与当前器官相关的描述和结论Performs organ MRI within the core organ aware 3d vit mri report clip computation pathway.
  6. 06
    PubMedBERT text encoder先在 MRI 报告上以 MLM 继续预训练Performs PubMedBERT text encoder within the core organ aware 3d vit mri report clip computation pathway.
  7. 07
    双线性投影到 512 维projection 512视觉和文本 [CLS] 映射到共享空间Performs projection 512 within the core organ aware 3d vit mri report clip computation pathway.
  8. 08
    Image-report contrastive stage同 study series/report 为正，器官内采样硬负并避免同 study 假负Applies Image-report contrastive stage to project aggregated representations toward the target task head.
  9. 09
    冻结 encoder + 轻量 decoderencoder + decoder分类、回归、检索、分割和定位任务Produces 512-d shared 3d mri–text embedding and frozen 3d visual features for lightweight downstream decoders via encoder + decoder.
MATHEMATICAL FORMALISM
核心公式 · 三维自蒸馏、体素块掩码与器官感知图文对齐
Core Formalism · 3D Self-Distilled ViT + Organ-Aware Multi-Sequence MRI-to-Report Contrastive Alignment
01 // PRIOR LIMITATION
上一代瓶颈

3D MRI 标签稀缺且传统视觉预训练难吸收放射学语义

3D MRI lacks massive manual labels, while naive global report alignment ignores which series or organ corresponds to which report sentence.

02 // CORE HYPOTHESIS
核心想法

先以 DINOv2 式视觉自监督学习 3D MRI 表示，再做 report-guided contrastive alignment

Pretrain a 3D ViT via self-distillation on ~200,000 MRI series, then align series embeddings with organ-parsed radiology report segments.

03 // ARCHITECTURAL DELTA
关键改进

在约 200000 个 MRI series、22000 余个 studies 上连接体积级视觉 token、多序列 MRI 与临床文本

Native 8×8×8 3D patch ViT + 3D DINOv2/iBOT visual SSL + organ-gated cross-modal contrastive learning.

04 // MEDICAL TRANSLATION
医学适配

用于 3D MRI 检索、分类和跨任务迁移

Supports zero-shot 3D MRI retrieval, disease classification, and label-efficient segmentation/grading across organs.

05 // EVIDENCE & BOUNDARY
适用范围与证据

新近 3D 医学 VLM；数据覆盖、文本泄漏和独立复现仍需检验，专属预训练代码/权重未开放

Recent 3D MRI VLM preprint; pretraining weights/code are not fully public, requiring independent verification.

ARCHITECTURAL AXIOMS // 设计原理与数学机制
  • Stage 1 独立预训练 3D 视觉 encoder 和医学文本 encoder。
  • 视觉侧用 DINOv2 student—teacher 与 iBOT 遮挡 patch 学全局和局部表示。
  • Stage 2 将 3D ViT 与 PubMedBERT 投影到 512 维共享空间，按器官和 study 规则做图文对比。
  • Core Hypothesis: Pretrain a 3D ViT via self-distillation on ~200,000 MRI series, then align series embeddings with organ-parsed radiology report segments.
  • Architectural Delta: Native 8×8×8 3D patch ViT + 3D DINOv2/iBOT visual SSL + organ-gated cross-modal contrastive learning.
  • Mathematical Formalism: 3D Self-Distilled ViT + Organ-Aware Multi-Sequence MRI-to-Report Contrastive Alignment.
CLINICAL TRANSLATION & BOUNDARIES // 医学应用与安全边界
  • 原生 3D token 与报告弱监督共同支持 MRI 检索、分类、分割和异常定位。
  • 报告是 study 级而 series 是局部输入，配对噪声和文本泄漏必须通过同 study 采样、外部集与无文本消融检验。
  • Clinical Translation: Supports zero-shot 3D MRI retrieval, disease classification, and label-efficient segmentation/grading across organs.
  • Evidence & Safety Boundary: Recent 3D MRI VLM preprint; pretraining weights/code are not fully public, requiring independent verification.
PRIMARY LITERATURE // 原始文献 Decipher-MR: A Vision-Language Foundation Model for 3D MRI Representations
OFFICIAL IMPLEMENTATION // 开源代码 未提供官方实现No Official Repository
